# BgClear

> Free online background remover tool. Remove image backgrounds instantly, in your browser, with no signup, no watermark, and no image uploaded to a server. Supports bulk processing of up to 20 images at once.

## About
BgClear is a 100% free, ad-supported AI background remover. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo (up to 10MB) and BgClear removes the background using an in-browser AI model, then lets you download a transparent PNG. No account, no credit card, no watermark.

## Technical
- Processing happens client-side in the browser (no image upload to a server).
- Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WebP (up to 10MB).
- No signup, no watermark, free tier has no limits on number of images.
